rules.title: No placeholder shipped as finished
rules.text: A document that presents itself as finished does not carry TODO, TBD, WIP or 'coming soon'. Work that is not done is either absent or named as absent — 'no --root flag exists' is a fact; 'to be added' is a promise.

judgement.question: Is this a placeholder for work that was not done, in a document that reads as finished?

criteria.true: it marks something as unfinished, undecided or to come
criteria.false: it is inside a command or a quoted pattern that searches for such markers, a fixture or template where the placeholder is the point, or a statement of a feature's absence as a fact
